Check whether Rich detects stdout as a terminal; non-terminal output may not interpret carriage returns as cursor movement. The `flush` argument only flushes output; it does not move the cursor. See [terminal detection in the Console docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/console.rst). For usage questions, please use [Rich Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
